Ballast Bracing.name: Ballast Bracing
Ballast Bracing.description: The user stretches both arms around a fallen beam, a tipping car or a pinned person and halves its weight with a springy lift so one rescuer can pull the survivor clear, or floods their own frame with weight to hold a door or ally immovable until the end of their next turn. It handles only half the mass a pure gravity user could float, and jagged metal or fire wounds the stretched arms. Strain: heavy.
